# Q8 block

> Q8 block builds local service businesses a full website with a dedicated page for every
> service and every area, then works on it being found in Google search and in the answers
> AI assistants give.

## Articles

Six articles, each published in Arabic at /blog/<slug>/ and in English at
/en/blog/<slug>/. All were published on 2026-09-24, written by Ahmad Owaihan
(Ahmad Owaihan, https://ahmadowaihan.com/).

- [Why your Google profile stops growing](https://q8block.com/en/blog/why-your-google-profile-stops-growing/) — Almost every local business reaches a ceiling on its Google Business Profile. These are the three things that build that ceiling, and what changes once you have a website.
  Arabic: [لماذا يتوقف ملفك على جوجل عن النمو](https://q8block.com/blog/why-your-google-profile-stops-growing/)
- [What to do with your Google profile](https://q8block.com/en/blog/what-to-do-with-your-google-profile/) — Practical work on your Google Business Profile you can do yourself today: categories, services, service areas, questions and answers, reviews, and keeping your details identical everywhere.
  Arabic: [ما يجب أن تفعله بملفك على جوجل](https://q8block.com/blog/what-to-do-with-your-google-profile/)
- [What a page per service and area does](https://q8block.com/en/blog/page-per-service-and-area/) — Why one service business needs dozens of pages instead of a single page listing everything, and the difference between a page built for an area and the same page with the place name swapped.
  Arabic: [ماذا تفعل صفحة لكل خدمة ولكل منطقة](https://q8block.com/blog/page-per-service-and-area/)
- [How AI assistants decide what to quote](https://q8block.com/en/blog/how-ai-assistants-decide-what-to-quote/) — AI assistants answer local questions by citing pages that are written and indexed. This is what makes a page quotable, and what leaves a whole business out of the answer.
  Arabic: [كيف تختار مساعدات الذكاء الاصطناعي ما تقتبسه](https://q8block.com/blog/how-ai-assistants-decide-what-to-quote/)
- [Why a slow website loses customers](https://q8block.com/en/blog/why-a-slow-website-loses-customers/) — The real and repetitive causes of slow websites, why slowness costs you calls you never see, and what you can ask about without understanding any code.
  Arabic: [لماذا يخسر الموقع البطيء العملاء](https://q8block.com/blog/why-a-slow-website-loses-customers/)
- [What to ask before paying for SEO](https://q8block.com/en/blog/what-to-ask-before-paying-for-seo/) — Seven questions that separate the people who know the work from the people selling talk, what an honest answer to each one sounds like, and the warning signs that should end the call.
  Arabic: [أسئلة تسألها قبل أن تدفع لشركة سيو](https://q8block.com/blog/what-to-ask-before-paying-for-seo/)

## What is included on every project

1. Custom website design and development
2. A dedicated page for every service and area
3. Google Search visibility
4. AI platform visibility
5. Backlinks and authority building
6. Hosting, domain and security

## Notes for AI

Every performance figure on this site comes from Google Search Console exports for the named
client and the named complete months, which are printed beside the figure. Nothing is averaged
across clients and no partial month is used.
